def: Hindmost; nearest the stern; as, the mizzen shrouds, sails,etc.

The plural nominative case of the pronoun of the first person;the word with which a person in speaking or writing denotes a numberor company of which he is one, as the subject of an action expressedby a verb.
To decorate; to beautify. [Obs.]To decore and beautify the house of God. E. Hall.
To engage in a raffle; as, to raffle for a watch.
To recover its natural or metallic state, as a metal.
An American compound ascidian (Amoræcium stellatum) which formslarge whitish masses resembling salt pork.
